metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Cassini clear-filter observations projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

metadata.label: False color
metadata.coverage: Cassini ISS NAC red, green and blue filters projected independently with the released PDS shape-camera table. Colors explicitly encode those three filters as red, green and blue; they are a registered false-color display, not natural color or a calibrated albedo map. Gray grid marks terrain outside the common reliable observation footprint and cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

celestial.sunSource: Vendored JPL Saturn satellite orbit and the Archinal rotation frame documented with the PDS shape model.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: Cassini clear-filter observations projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

controls.label: False color
controls.notes: Cassini ISS NAC red, green and blue filters projected independently with the released PDS shape-camera table. Colors explicitly encode those three filters as red, green and blue; they are a registered false-color display, not natural color or a calibrated albedo map. Gray grid marks terrain outside the common reliable observation footprint and cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed. Blue was captured almost nine minutes before red, at a phase angle of 43 degrees versus 33 degrees. Hue can reflect changing illumination as well as filter response; it does not establish composition.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Radial height above a 10.7 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
